snippet.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

Find out more at www.hellletloose.com

Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is developed on Unreal Engine 5 for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and is the newest entry in the Hell Let Loose franchise.
 
You can join the community today on Discord and Reddit, and stay up to date with the latest announcements by following us on our social channels.

Hell Let Loose Social Channels:
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/hellletloose
